notes.title: 4K video
notes.content:
[h1]更新公告[/h1]

4K画质包测试版更新10.10

经过小恋3号机的1个月的努力导出。终于导出了所有的4K高清素材。有想下载高清版本游戏的玩家老爷们可通过以下步骤进行下载游玩

第一步：在游戏库中右键点击游戏程序《重生了还要我谈恋爱？》，选择属性

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45092597/5294761dcd7f72689f07b60eb9935bf6fbecb15b.png[/img]

第二步：属性栏中选择“测试版”，在右上角切换4K视频源

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45092597/e671d6dc3c7b5a4fdb05139d810c53829014ebc1.png[/img]

第三步：等待更新下载完成即可

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45092597/bbcaaad5f595b45113aaa7e19f5a14d4a3b5ebeb.jpg[/img]




感谢玩家的等待

PS：我们的第二部作品正在筹备策划中......敬请期待

notes.title: Know before you play Welfare & Updates
notes.content:
[h2] welfare[/h2]
After in-depth communication with the beta players, the production team decided to invest most of the publicity budget (although it was not much) into the welfare of the players. Although the production team is poor, our sincerity must be full.
Welfare-related activities, please also ask players to move: group 938160799
As for the problem of not being announced, I also hope that players who like it can recommend it to their friends, and if they think it is Gou, we fully accept criticism.
No matter how many players there are, no matter whether the reviews are good or bad, we will try our best to serve every player.

[h2] about the update[/h2]
Thanks to the beta leaders for their sincere comments to us, we have tried our best to fix a lot of questions. However, there are still some issues to be solved, and we will continue to optimize the following aspects after launch.
--4K image quality update package (sound and picture corrections)
--Optimized the UI interface.
--Stuttering issues caused by game pause.

If you have any other questions about the game, please feel free to contact us.

[h2] About the actor[/h2]
What we are most proud of in this game is the appearance of several leading teachers (in private, it looks better than in the camera, and if the shooting is not good, it is our pot).
Although most of them are not from professional backgrounds, they are surprisingly good, which really surprises us. I was really lucky to have them here (and the luck component was really big).
I also hope that the players who like it can praise them fiercely without hesitation! I believe that this will also be of great help to their future career choices.

[h2] About Us[/h2]
We are a small team from Shenzhen, we don't have much money, and we don't have strong strength. The main creative team fought for 5 months with enthusiasm and zero salary.
There are indeed many things in the production that even we are not satisfied with, and there are also many of them because of our own SB, which leads to some flaws in the game (including post-production, the sound is not up to professional standards, etc.).
Please bear with me (please also spray lightly).

[h2] About the future[/h2]
During the development and production of the game... We have indeed found a lot of improvements and the huge potential of film and television interactive games, and more gameplay and interactive innovations are worth exploring and trying. If we have the opportunity to develop it again, we have a lot of confidence to make a more playable work for everyone.
I also hope that everyone can support domestic film and television interactive games.
